CI_CD_server.src.models.build module¶

class CI_CD_server.src.models.build.Build(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)[source]¶

Bases: Model

Represents a build in the database.

This class models build records with commit identifiers, build output logs, timestamps, and status information. Each build is associated with a specific commit in the version control system.

__init__(commit_sha, logs, status)[source]¶

Initialize a new Build object.

Parameters:

  • commit_sha (str) – Commit SHA for the build.

  • logs (str) – Build logs.

  • status (str) – Build status.

static add_build(commit_sha, logs, status)[source]¶

Add a new build to the database.

Parameters:

  • commit_sha (str) – Commit SHA for the build.

  • logs (str) – Build logs.

  • status (str) – Build status.

Example

>>> Build.add_build("abcdef123456", "Build logs...", "success")
Adding build to database.
